results.title: Rail freight giant DB Cargo shunts UK operation into sale process
results.description: One of Britain's biggest rail freight operators is being put up for sale as its state-owned German parent confronts financial challenges in its domestic and wider European businesses. Sky News has learnt that DB Cargo UK is working with advisers at Interpath on an auction, with talks already underway with prospective bidders. Reports suggest that DB Cargo UK's loss-making German parent planned to cut more than 6,000 jobs in its home market by 2030 - equating to roughly half its workforce in the country.

results.description: Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc (NYSE:APAM) recently announced a total dividend of $0.8 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-17.
